verdict.rationale: Devin's docs describe multiple natural-language interaction modes—delegating tasks via Slack/Teams, web app, IDE, CLI, and API—all driven by plain-language task descriptions (devin-docs-1,3,4,5,8). This is core to the product's design as an agentic AI engineer operated conversationally. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that natural-language commands reliably produce correct results (community threads raise general reliability skepticism, devin-comm-2,4,6,9, but don't concretely dispute the NL interface itself).
